design.name: 🔄 CP Navigation
design.note: Swaps the whole Control Panel instance embedded in Shell Desktop, choosing between Top, Drill Down Left, Tree Left and Flat Icon Desktop. Default resolves to CP → (Def) Drill Down - Desktop - Left (Beta), Expanded=True.

design.name: 🔀 Sub Navigation Desktop Position
design.note: In shell-mobile the equivalent property is named 🔀 Sub Navigation Mobile Position and offers Top and Bottom instead of Top and Left.
